activity.notes: Broad conventional window for the Gideon/Jerubbaal traditions in Judges 6–8 during the premonarchic period. The interval is deliberately uncertain. The Jerubbaal inscription from Khirbet al-Ra'i is not treated as identification of this individual.

sources.title: Hebrew Bible — Judges 6–8
sources.citation_text: Primary textual source for Gideon, also called Jerubbaal, as a judge in the premonarchic Israelite tradition.

review_context.historicity_policy: Person retained as a historical-core candidate while Activity confidence is disputed; chronology is a broad conventional range, not a precise date claim.
review_context.polity_binding_note: Israel is the existing neutral premonarchic polity, not Kingdom of Israel.
